name: dioramas
description: A free, open-source framework for cinematic, interactive 3D websites with AI-generated assets (Nano Banana 2 + Meshy 7.1 on fal). 20 example sites.
readme_summary: Dioramas is an open-source framework for creating cinematic, interactive 3D websites. It leverages AI to generate 3D assets from text prompts, which are then optimized and integrated into a three.js engine for visually rich, scroll-driven experiences.
key_features: three.js based engine with advanced post-processing effects
No CLI installation or paid tier
primary_use_case: Building interactive, visually stunning 3D landing pages and websites with AI-generated assets.
cover_image_prompt: A magical artisan's workshop where a digital loom weaves intricate 3D models from glowing threads of text prompts. On one side, a screen displays a simple text prompt like 'ancient artifact'. On the other, a finished, detailed 3D model of the artifact materializes, ready to be placed into a beautiful, cinematic website scene. Subtle UI elements and code snippets float around the artisan, hinting at the framework's technical nature. The overall mood is one of creative generation and seamless integration into a digital experience. Style: 3D isometric illustration, vibrant colors, clean composition.

name: Liquid-glass-studio
description: Design the iOS 26 liquid glass effect visually and copy production-ready CSS or Tailwind in one click. Vanilla JS, zero dependencies, no build step.
readme_summary: Liquid Glass Studio is a zero-dependency, vanilla JavaScript web application that allows users to visually design and generate CSS or Tailwind CSS code for the iOS 26 liquid glass effect. It provides a live preview with fine-tuned controls and the ability to use custom backgrounds, making it easy to replicate complex frosted glass designs.
key_features: Visual design of iOS 26 liquid glass effect
One-click CSS and Tailwind CSS code generation
Draggable live preview with 7 fine-tuned controls (blur, milkiness, saturation, radius, depth, edge light, refraction bend)
Optional edge refraction via SVG displacement filter
Support for custom backgrounds (upload, drag-and-drop, paste)
Zero dependencies, zero build step, plain HTML/CSS/JS
primary_use_case: To provide a user-friendly, visual tool for designers and developers to easily create and export CSS code for the iOS 26 liquid glass effect without requiring any build tools or dependencies.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical alchemist in a brightly lit, minimalist studio, holding a glowing vial labeled 'Liquid Glass'. They are pouring the liquid onto a digital canvas, which instantly transforms into a beautifully rendered, translucent frosted glass panel with a subtle light edge. Around the alchemist, sliders and simple UI elements are visible, representing the design controls. In the background, a blurred, colorful abstract landscape serves as the source for the glass effect. The overall mood is creative and effortless. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and vibrant, soft lighting, emphasizing the magical transformation of raw elements into a polished UI component. The repository name 'Liquid Glass Studio' is subtly etched on a workbench.
